ideas.title: AI-Powered Micro-Review Assistant
ideas.problem: Gen Z shoppers face choice overload with 500+ reviews per product. They abandon carts when they can't quickly assess if a product matches their specific needs.
ideas.persona: Gen Z online shoppers (18-25) buying fashion/electronics on marketplaces
assumptions: Users trust AI-summarized reviews as much as reading 10+ reviews
Conversion rate increases by 15%+ when review friction is reduced

ideas.title: Predictive Churn Prevention Dashboard
ideas.problem: SaaS companies lose 5-7% MRR monthly to churn they could have predicted. PMs lack real-time signals to identify at-risk users before they cancel.
ideas.persona: SaaS Product Managers managing products with 10K+ users
assumptions: Usage pattern changes precede churn by 14+ days
PMs will act on churn alerts within 48 hours

ideas.title: Cross-Platform Content Repurposing Engine
ideas.problem: Content creators spend 6+ hours per piece repurposing for different platforms. Each platform has unique format requirements that manual adaptation misses.
ideas.persona: Content creators and marketing PMs managing multi-platform presence
assumptions: Platform-specific formatting is the #1 time drain
AI-adapted content performs within 80% of manually crafted posts

research.title: E-commerce Review UX — Competitive Landscape
research.summary: Analyzed review presentation across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Meesho. Found that AI-summarized reviews (Amazon's approach) reduce decision time by 40% but trust drops 15% without source attribution.
keyFindings: Amazon's AI review summary has 72% user trust (Baymard Institute 2025)
Flipkart's photo reviews get 3x more engagement than text
Myntra's style-match ratings reduce returns by 22%

research.title: SaaS Churn Prediction — TAM Analysis
research.summary: Estimating TAM for predictive churn analytics tools. Bottom-up: 180K SaaS companies × $5K avg annual spend = $900M TAM. Cross-referenced with Gartner 2025 customer analytics market report.
keyFindings: Only 23% of SaaS companies use predictive churn tools
Average ROI of churn prevention: 5x cost of tool

prds.title: PRD: AI Review Summarizer — Browser Extension MVP
prds.author: Arpit Tripathi
prds.problemStatement: Online shoppers spend 23 minutes average reading reviews before purchase decisions. 67% of cart abandonments cite 'too many conflicting reviews' as a factor.
goals: Reduce review reading time by 60% for target users
Achieve 70%+ trust score for AI-generated summaries
Drive 15% increase in add-to-cart conversion rate
nonGoals: Not building a full e-commerce platform
Not handling seller-facing analytics in v1

prototypes.title: BuyWise Extension — Review Summary Card
prototypes.testResults: 4/5 users found summaries helpful. 1 user wanted source attribution for each point.
